7 Terminal Headlight Switch 1968-1972 GTO/Lemans 1968-1981 Firebird and Bonneville


Reproduction 7-terminal headlamp switch for a wide variety of 1969-1996 GM models. This switch mounts on the dash and controls the flow of electrical current to the headlamp system. Each switch comes without the knob or shaft, sold separately
